findings.title: Root site is disallowed for all crawlers including AI retrieval agents
findings.evidence: Observed at https://dentsu.com/robots.txt via robots_txt_parser_longest_match [2026-09-13T15:42:26Z]: robots.txt disallows root '/' for user-agent '*', blocking all AI bots (CCBot, Meta-ExternalAgent, Bytespider, Amazonbot). (Confidence: high)

suggested_action.summary: Update robots.txt to allow crawling of public landing and product pages.
suggested_action.how_to_fix: Ensure 'User-agent: * / Disallow: /' is removed or narrowed to private authenticated directories only.
suggested_action.expected_benefit: Improves crawlability by making the observed information clearer and more extractable for the intended audience.
